capacity_metric_note: Q_sim integrates the experimentally measured current over the experimental time window, so Q_sim ~= Q_exp by construction.  Do NOT read baseline Q_sim-Q_exp as a capacity prediction; predictive capacity requires a constant-current run where the model itself reaches the cutoff.

parameter_match.experimental_cell: NCM920305 || Li metal half cell, 2 mAh/cm2 (14.8 mm disc, 1.72 cm2)
parameter_match.notes: Matched half-cell pilot: the authors used the same electrode loading to parameterise this PyBaMM set and published both the experimental CSVs and the model outputs.  H2 identity check shows our 5 rate files are row-identical to the files the authors' saved model outputs were computed from (|V_ours - V_sim| deviates from their logged absolute error by ~25 uV median).  Wording: numerically matched to the dataset used in the authors' simulations -- NOT cryptographically identical.  First replay is as-published (D scaling = 1.0), ZERO fitting.
